question_mn: Ам.долларын хүсэлтүүдийн хамгийн их хүссэн хугацаа хэдэн сар вэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin hvseltvvdiin hamgiin ih hvssen hugatsaa heden sar we?
question_en: What is the longest requested term, in months, among USD applications?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(requested_term_months) AS max_term_months FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'USD'

question_mn: 2025 онд зээлийн хүсэлт гаргасан давхардаагүй харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond zeeliin khuselt gargasan davkhardaagui khariltsagch hed ve?
question_en: How many distinct customers submitted a loan application in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: Дефолтын магадлал нь 10 хувиас өндөр гарсан скоринг хэд байна?
question_latin: Defoltiin magadlal ni 10 huwias undur garsan skoring hed baina?
question_en: How many credit scores have an estimated probability of default above 10%?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE pd_estimate > 0.10

question_mn: ЖДҮ-ийн скорингийн моделиор хэдэн хүсэлт үнэлэгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: JDU-iin skoringiin modeliar kheden khuselt unelegdsen be?
question_en: How many applications were scored with the SME application scoring model?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE model_code = 'APP_SCORE_SME'

question_mn: Энэ сард ирсэн төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдээс хамгийн их хүссэн дүн хэд байв?
question_latin: Ene sard irsen tugrugiin hvseltvvdees hamgiin ih hvssen dvn hed baiw?
question_en: What was the largest requested amount among MNT applications received this month?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(requested_amount) FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: LA-2025-000894 дугаартай хүсэлтийн төлөв, хүссэн дүн, батлагдсан дүнг харуул
question_latin: LA-2025-000894 dugaartai khuseltiin tolov, khussen dun, batlagdsan dung kharuul
question_en: Show the status, requested amount and approved amount of application LA-2025-000894.
gold_sql: SELECT status_name, requested_amount, approved_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE application_no = 'LA-2025-000894'

question_mn: Гурав ба түүнээс олон удаа зээлийн хүсэлт гаргасан харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Guraw ba tvvnees olon udaa zeeliin hvselt gargasan hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many customers have submitted three or more loan applications?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) >= 3) t

question_mn: Батлагдсан хүсэлтүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь гэрээ байгуулж зээл болсон бэ?
question_latin: Batlagdsan khuseltuudiin kheden khuvi ni geree baiguulj zeel bolson be?
question_en: What percentage of approved applications went on to sign a contract and become loans?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 'CONTRACTED') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')), 0), 2) AS conversion_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications

question_mn: 2026 оны 1-р улиралд Зээлийн хороогоор батлагдсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтийн тоо болон нийт батлагдсан дүнг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 1-r ulirald Zeeliin horoogoor batlagdsan tugrugiin hvseltiin too bolon niit batlagdsan dvng garga
question_en: Show the number of MNT applications approved by the Credit Committee in Q1 2026 and their total approved amount.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS applications, SUM(approved_amount) AS total_approved FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE decision_level = 'CREDIT_COMMITTEE' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND decided_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question_mn: Харилцагчийн сегмент бүрээр хүсэлтийн дундаж скорингийн оноог гарга
question_latin: Khariltsagchiin segment bureer khuseltiin dundaj skoringiin onoog garga
question_en: Show the average application credit score for each customer segment.
question_mixed: Customer segment бүрээр хүсэлтийн average credit score-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, ROUND(AVG(a.credit_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл тус бүрээр хүсэлтүүдийн DTI-ийн медиан утгыг гарга
question_latin: Bvteegdehvvnii turul tus bvreer hvseltvvdiin DTI-iin median utgiig garga
question_en: Show the median DTI of applications for each product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.dti_ratio)::numeric, 2) AS median_dti FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Жил бүр суваг тус бүрээс хэдэн хүсэлт ирснийг гарга
question_latin: Jil bur suvag tus burees kheden khuselt irsniig garga
question_en: Show how many applications came from each channel in each year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM submitted_date)::int AS year, channel, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY 1, 2

question_mn: Долоо хоногийн өдөр бүрээр зээлийн хүсэлтийн тоог гарга (1 = даваа)
question_latin: Doloo honogiin udur bvreer zeeliin hvseltiin toog garga (1 = dawaa)
question_en: Show the number of loan applications by day of the week (1 = Monday).
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM submitted_date)::int AS weekday, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Ажлаас гарсан зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүд тус бүр нийт хэдэн хүсэлт хариуцаж байсныг гарга
question_latin: Ajlaas garsan zeeliin mergejiltnuud tus bur niit kheden khuselt khariutsaj baisniig garga
question_en: For each loan officer who has left the company, show how many applications they handled in total.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.loan_officer_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'TERMINATED' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name

question_mn: Хүсэлт илгээснээс зээл олгох хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног болдгийг бүтээгдэхүүн бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Hvselt ilgeesnees zeel olgoh hvrtel dundjaar heden honog boldgiig bvteegdehvvn bvreer garga
question_en: For each product, show the average number of days from application submission to loan disbursement.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(l.disbursement_date - a.submitted_date), 2) AS avg_days FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.application_id = a.application_id JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: Батлагдсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийн хувьд нийт хүссэн дүнгийн хэдэн хувийг баталсан бэ? Шийдвэрийн түвшин бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Batlagdsan tugrugiin hvseltvvdiin huwid niit hvssen dvngiin heden huwiig batalsan be? Shiidweriin tvwshin bvreer garga
question_en: For approved MNT applications, what percentage of the total requested amount was approved? Show it by decision level.
gold_sql: SELECT decision_level, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(approved_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(requested_amount), 0), 2) AS approved_share_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') GROUP BY decision_level

question_mn: 2025 онд сар бүр батлагдсан төгрөгийн зээлийн нийт дүн болон оны эхнээс хуримтлагдсан дүнг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond sar bur batlagdsan togrogiin zeeliin niit dun bolon onii ekhnees khurimtlagdsan dung garga
question_en: For 2025, show the total MNT amount approved each month and the cumulative year-to-date approved amount.
question_mixed: 2025 онд сар бүр approve хийсэн төгрөгийн зээлийн дүн болон running total-ыг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM decided_date)::int AS month, SUM(approved_amount) AS approved_amount, SUM(SUM(approved_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM decided_date)::int) AS cumulative_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') AND decided_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
notes: Сар нь шийдвэрийн огноогоор (decided_date).

question_mn: Энэ онд ирсэн хүсэлтүүдийн хэд нь тухайн харилцагчийн анхны хүсэлт, хэд нь давтан хүсэлт байсан бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond irsen hvseltvvdiin hed ni tuhain hariltsagchiin anhnii hvselt, hed ni dawtan hvselt baisan be?
question_en: Of the applications received this year, how many were the customer's first-ever application and how many were repeat applications?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT submitted_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY submitted_date, application_no) AS rn FROM t2s.loan_applications) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn > 1) AS repeat_applications FROM x WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Нэгээс олон хүсэлт гаргасан харилцагчдын хувьд дараалсан хоёр хүсэлтийн хооронд дунджаар хэдэн хоног байдаг вэ?
question_latin: Negees olon hvselt gargasan hariltsagchdiin huwid daraalsan hoyor hvseltiin hoorond dundjaar heden honog baidag we?
question_en: For customers with more than one application, what is the average number of days between consecutive applications?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT submitted_date - LAG(submitted_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY submitted_date, application_no) AS gap_days FROM t2s.loan_applications) SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap_days), 2) AS avg_gap_days FROM x WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL

question_mn: 2025 онд салбар бүрт ирсэн хүсэлтийн тоо болон нийт хүсэлтэд эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond salbar bvrt irsen hvseltiin too bolon niit hvseltend ezleh huwiig garga
question_en: For 2025, show the number of applications submitted at each branch and its share of all applications.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) AS applications, ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / SUM(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Хаагдсан Баянгол-2 тооцооны төв 2026 онд 0 хүсэлттэй (-100%).

question_mn: Салбаруудыг төрлөөр нь ангилаад төрөл бүрт хэд байгааг гарга.
question_latin: Salbaruudiig turluur ni angilaad turul bvrt hed baigaag garga
question_en: Group the branches by type and show how many there are of each type.
gold_sql: SELECT branch_type, count(*) AS branch_count FROM t2s.branches GROUP BY branch_type

question_mn: Доктор зэрэгтэй хэдэн харилцагч байна?
question_latin: Doktor zeregtei kheden khariltsagch baina?
question_en: How many customers hold a doctoral degree?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE education_level = 'Доктор'

question_mn: Хөдөлмөр эрхлэлтийн төрөл бүрээр хувь хүн харилцагчдын хамгийн бага, хамгийн их сарын орлогыг гарга
question_latin: Hudulmur erhleltiin turul bvreer huwi hvn hariltsagchdiin hamgiin baga, hamgiin ih sariin orlogiig garga
question_en: For each employment type, show the minimum and maximum monthly income of individual customers.
gold_sql: SELECT employment_type, MIN(monthly_income) AS min_income, MAX(monthly_income) AS max_income FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY employment_type

question_mn: 2000 оноос өмнө байгуулагдсан байгууллага харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2000 onoos omno baiguulagdsan baiguullaga khariltsagch khed ve?
question_en: How many organization customers were founded before 2000?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.organizations WHERE establishment_date < DATE '2000-01-01'

question_mn: Налайх тооцооны төв аль салбарын харьяанд байдаг вэ?
question_latin: Nalaih tootsoonii tuw ali salbariin hariyaand baidag we?
question_en: Which branch does the Nalaikh settlement center belong to?
gold_sql: SELECT p.branch_name FROM t2s.branches b JOIN t2s.branches p ON p.branch_id = b.parent_branch_id WHERE b.branch_name = 'Налайх тооцооны төв'

question_mn: Хэлтэс, алба бүрт ажиллаж байгаа ажилтны тоог гарга. Хэлтэст харьяалагддаггүй удирдлагыг оруулахгүй.
question_latin: Kheltes, alba burt ajillaj baigaa ajiltnii toog garga. Kheltest kharyaalagddaggui udirdlagiig oruulakhgui
question_en: Show the number of currently working employees in each department, excluding management that belongs to no department.
gold_sql: SELECT department_name, count(*) AS employee_count FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND department_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department_name

question_mn: Манай харилцагчид хамгийн олноор ажилладаг 5 байгууллагын нэр, тэнд ажилладаг харилцагчийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Manai hariltsagchid hamgiin olnoor ajilladag 5 baiguullagiin ner, tend ajilladag hariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: Show the 5 employers where the largest number of our customers work, with the number of customers at each.
question_mixed: Манай клиентүүд хамгийн олноор ажилладаг top 5 employer-ийг тоотой нь гарга
gold_sql: SELECT employer_name, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.individuals WHERE employer_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employer_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC, employer_name LIMIT 5

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдыг сарын орлогоор нь 4 тэнцүү бүлэгт хувааж, бүлэг бүрийн хамгийн бага, хамгийн их орлогыг гарга
question_latin: Huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig sariin orlogoor ni 4 tentsvv bvlegt huwaaj, bvleg bvriin hamgiin baga, hamgiin ih orlogiig garga
question_en: Split individual customers into 4 equal groups by monthly income and show the minimum and maximum income of each group.
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT monthly_income, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_income) AS quartile FROM t2s.individuals) SELECT quartile, MIN(monthly_income) AS min_income, MAX(monthly_income) AS max_income FROM q GROUP BY quartile

question_mn: Хамгийн эрт байгуулагдсан 3 байгууллага харилцагчийн нэр, байгуулагдсан огноог гарга.
question_latin: Hamgiin ert baiguulagdsan 3 baiguullaga hariltsagchiin ner, baiguulagdsan ognoog garga
question_en: Show the names and founding dates of the 3 earliest-founded organization customers.
gold_sql: SELECT org_name, establishment_date FROM t2s.organizations ORDER BY establishment_date, customer_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: Мөнгө угаалтын шалгалтын төлөв тус бүрээр харилцагчийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Mungu ugaaltiin shalgaltiin tuluw tus bvreer hariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: Show the number of customers for each AML screening status.
question_mixed: AML статус бүрээр клиентийн тоог гарга
gold_sql: SELECT aml_status, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers GROUP BY aml_status

question_mn: Улаанбаатарын дүүрэг бүрт хэдэн харилцагч амьдардаг вэ?
question_latin: Ulaanbaatariin duureg burt kheden khariltsagch amidardag ve?
question_en: How many customers live in each district of Ulaanbaatar?
gold_sql: SELECT district, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers WHERE province = 'Улаанбаатар' GROUP BY district

question_mn: 2020 оноос өмнө нээгдсэн салбаруудын нэр, нээгдсэн огноог жагсаа.
question_latin: 2020 onoos umnu neegdsen salbaruudiin ner, neegdsen ognoog jagsaa
question_en: List the names and opening dates of the branches opened before 2020.
gold_sql: SELECT branch_name, opened_date FROM t2s.branches WHERE opened_date < DATE '2020-01-01'

question_mn: Хэлтэс бүрт хамгийн сүүлд хэзээ ажилтан авсныг гарга
question_latin: Heltes bvrt hamgiin svvld hezee ajiltan awsniig garga
question_en: For each department, show when the most recent employee was hired.
gold_sql: SELECT department_name, MAX(hire_date) AS last_hire_date FROM t2s.employees WHERE department_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department_name

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай байгууллага харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei hadgalamjtai baiguullaga hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many organization customers have an active deposit?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c WHERE c.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE')

question_mn: Хоёр ба түүнээс дээш асрамжийн хүнтэй харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Khoyor ba tuunees deesh asramjiin khuntei khariltsagch khed ve?
question_en: How many customers have two or more dependants?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE dependants_count >= 2

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн хамгийн анхны харилцагч хэзээ бүртгүүлснийг салбарын нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvriin hamgiin anhnii hariltsagch hezee bvrtgvvlsniig salbariin nertei ni garga
question_en: For each branch, show when its very first customer registered, together with the branch name.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, MIN(c.onboarded_date) AS first_onboarded FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Байгууллага харилцагчдыг ажилчдын тоогоор нь бичил (10 хүртэл), жижиг (10-49), дунд (50-249), том (250 ба түүнээс дээш) гэж ангилаад ангилал бүрийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Baiguullaga khariltsagchdiig ajilchdiin toogoor ni bichil (10 khurtel), jijig (10-49), dund (50-249), tom (250 ba tuunees deesh) gej angilaad angilal buriin toog garga
question_en: Classify organization customers by number of employees as micro (under 10), small (10-49), medium (50-249) and large (250 or more), and show the count in each class.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN employee_count < 10 THEN 'бичил' WHEN employee_count < 50 THEN 'жижиг' WHEN employee_count < 250 THEN 'дунд' ELSE 'том' END AS size_class, count(*) AS org_count FROM t2s.organizations GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Одоо ажиллаж байгаа ажилтнуудаас хамгийн удаан ажилласан 5 хүний нэр, ажилд орсон огноог гарга.
question_latin: Odoo ajillaj baigaa ajiltnuudaas hamgiin udaan ajillasan 5 hvnii ner, ajild orson ognoog garga
question_en: Among currently working employees, show the names and hire dates of the 5 with the longest service.
gold_sql: SELECT full_name, hire_date FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hire_date, employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: 2025 онд ажилд орсон ажилтнуудыг албан тушаалаар нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: 2025 ond ajild orson ajiltnuudiig alban tushaalaar ni toolj garga
question_en: Count the employees hired in 2025 by position.
question_mixed: 2025 онд hire хийгдсэн ажилтнуудыг position-оор нь тоол
gold_sql: SELECT position_name, count(*) AS hired_count FROM t2s.employees WHERE hire_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY position_name

question_mn: Салбаруудыг хувь хүн харилцагчдынх нь дундаж насаар залуугаас нь эхлэн эрэмбэлж, салбарын нэр, дундаж нас, эрэмбийн байрыг гарга.
question_latin: Salbaruudiig huwi hvn hariltsagchdiinh ni dundaj nasaar zaluugaas ni ehlen erembelj, salbariin ner, dundaj nas, erembiin bairiig garga
question_en: Rank the branches by the average age of their individual customers, youngest first, and show the branch name, average age and rank.
gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT b.branch_name, AVG(i.age) AS avg_age FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, ROUND(avg_age, 2) AS avg_age, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_age) AS age_rank FROM a ORDER BY age_rank

question_mn: Нээгдсэнээсээ хойш нэг ч гүйлгээ хийгдээгүй данс хэд байна?
question_latin: Neegdseneesee hoish neg ch gvilgee hiigdeegvi dans hed baina?
question_en: How many accounts have never had a transaction since they were opened?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.accounts WHERE last_transaction_date IS NULL

question_mn: Идэвхтэй төгрөгийн хадгаламжуудад хуримтлагдсан боловч олгогдоогүй байгаа хүү нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei togrogiin khadgalamjuudad khurimtlagdsan bolovch olgogdoogui baigaa khuu niit khed ve?
question_en: What is the total accrued but unpaid interest on active MNT deposits?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(accrued_interest) FROM t2s.deposits WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: 2025 онд хэдэн зээл олголтын гүйлгээ амжилттай хийгдсэн, нийт дүн нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond heden zeel olgoltiin gvilgee amjilttai hiigdsen, niit dvn ni hed we?
question_en: How many successful loan disbursement transactions were made in 2025, and what was their total amount?
question_mixed: 2025 онд хэдэн loan disbursement transaction амжилттай хийгдсэн, нийт amount нь хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tx_count, SUM(amount_mnt) AS total_amount FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'LOAN_DISB' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: 2025 онд амжилттай болсон төгрөгийн гүйлгээнүүдээс нийт хэдэн төгрөгийн шимтгэл авсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond amjilttai bolson togrogiin guilgeenuudees niit kheden togrogiin shimtgel avsan be?
question_en: How much fee was collected in total from successful MNT transactions in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(fee_amount) FROM t2s.transactions WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
notes: Шимтгэл зөвхөн мобайл, интернэт банкны зарлагын шилжүүлэгт (100₮) авагддаг.

question_mn: Ам.долларын ханш 3500 төгрөгөөс дээш гарсан хэдэн өдөр байсан бэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin hansh 3500 tugruguus deesh garsan heden udur baisan be?
question_en: On how many days was the USD exchange rate above 3,500 MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.exchange_rates WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND mid_rate > 3500

question_mn: Хүүхдийн хадгаламжийн хамгийн урт хугацаа хэдэн сар вэ?
question_latin: Hvvhdiin hadgalamjiin hamgiin urt hugatsaa heden sar we?
question_en: What is the longest term, in months, among child deposits?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(term_months) FROM t2s.deposits WHERE deposit_type = 'CHILD'

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцэст үлдэгдэл нь 100 сая төгрөгөөс давсан данс хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sariin etsest uldegdel ni 100 saya togrogoos davsan dans khed baisan be?
question_en: How many accounts had a month-end balance above 100 million MNT at the end of June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2s.account_balances_monthly WHERE balance_date = DATE '2026-06-30' AND closing_balance_mnt > 100000000

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай хувь хүн харилцагчдын дундаж нас хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei khadgalamjtai khuvi khun khariltsagchdiin dundaj nas khed ve?
question_en: What is the average age of individual customers who hold an active deposit?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.age), 2) FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай хувь хүн харилцагчдыг насны бүлгээр (30 хүртэл, 30-44, 45-59, 60+) тоолж гарга
question_latin: Idewhtei hadgalamjtai huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig nasnii bvleer (30 hvrtel, 30-44, 45-59, 60+) toolj garga
question_en: Count individual customers with an active deposit by age group (under 30, 30-44, 45-59, 60+).
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.age < 30 THEN '30 хүртэл' WHEN i.age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN i.age < 60 THEN '45-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_group, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай харилцагчдын тоог тэдний оршин суугаа аймаг, хотоор гарга
question_latin: Idevkhtei khadgalamjtai khariltsagchdiin toog tednii orshin suugaa aimag, khotoor garga
question_en: Show the number of customers with an active deposit by the province or city where they live.
gold_sql: SELECT c.province, COUNT(DISTINCT d.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM t2s.deposits d JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.province

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард хамгийн олон гүйлгээ хийгдсэн 3 өдөр, тухайн өдрүүдийн гүйлгээний тоог гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard hamgiin olon gvilgee hiigdsen 3 udur, tuhain udrvvdiin gvilgeenii toog garga
question_en: Show the 3 days in June 2026 with the most transactions, along with their transaction counts.
question_mixed: 2026 оны 6-р сарын хамгийн busy 3 өдөр, тухайн өдрүүдийн transaction count-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY tx_count DESC, transaction_date LIMIT 3

question_mn: 2026 оны 2-р улирлын гүйлгээний тоог гаригаар нь (даваа=1 ... ням=7) гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 2-r ulirliin guilgeenii toog garigaar ni (davaa=1 ... nyam=7) garga
question_en: Show the number of transactions in Q2 2026 by day of the week (Monday=1 ... Sunday=7).
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM transaction_date) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд сар бүр хадгаламжийн дансанд хүү тооцож нийт хэдэн төгрөг олгосныг сараар гарга
question_latin: Ene ond sar bvr hadgalamjiin dansand hvv tootsoj niit heden tugrug olgosniig saraar garga
question_en: For each month this year, show the total amount of interest credited to savings accounts.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) AS month, SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_credited FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'INTEREST_CREDIT' AND status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Энэ оны эхний хагаст бэлэн мөнгө тушаалтын дүн нь 10 тэрбум төгрөгөөс давсан салбаруудын нэр, дүнг гарга
question_latin: Ene onii ehnii hagast belen mungu tushaaltiin dvn ni 10 terbum tugrugees dawsan salbaruudiin ner, dvng garga
question_en: Show the names and amounts of branches whose cash deposits in the first half of this year exceeded 10 billion MNT.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(t.amount_mnt) AS total_amount FROM t2s.transactions t JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = t.branch_id WHERE t.transaction_type_code = 'CASH_DEPOSIT' AND t.status_code = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name HAVING SUM(t.amount_mnt) > 10000000000

question_mn: Жил бүр хэдэн хадгаламжийн данс нээгдсэнийг оноор нь гарга
question_latin: Jil bvr heden hadgalamjiin dans neegdseniig onoor ni garga
question_en: Show how many savings accounts were opened each year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opened_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS opened_count FROM t2s.accounts WHERE account_type_code = 'SAVINGS' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Хадгаламжуудыг сунгагдсан тоогоор нь бүлэглээд, бүлэг тус бүрт хэдэн хадгаламж байгааг гарга
question_latin: Hadgalamjuudiig sungagdsan toogoor ni bvlegleed, bvleg tus bvrt heden hadgalamj baigaag garga
question_en: Group deposits by the number of times they have been renewed and show how many deposits are in each group.
gold_sql: SELECT renewal_count, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count FROM t2s.deposits GROUP BY renewal_count

question_mn: Анх байршуулсан дүнгээсээ хамгийн их өссөн 5 идэвхтэй төгрөгийн хадгаламжийн дугаар, өсөлтийн дүнг гарга
question_latin: Ankh bairshuulsan dungeesee khamgiin ikh osson 5 idevkhtei togrogiin khadgalamjiin dugaar, osoltiin dung garga
question_en: Show the numbers and growth amounts of the 5 active MNT deposits whose balance has grown the most above the initial principal.
gold_sql: SELECT deposit_number, current_balance - principal_amount AS growth FROM t2s.deposits WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY growth DESC, deposit_number LIMIT 5

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард гүйлгээ хийсэн харилцагч бүр дунджаар хэдэн гүйлгээ хийсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard gvilgee hiisen hariltsagch bvr dundjaar heden gvilgee hiisen be?
question_en: In June 2026, how many transactions on average did each transacting customer make?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(tx_count), 2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY customer_id) x

question_mn: Валют бүрийн 2026 оны 6-р сарын 30-ны ханшийг 2025 оны 12-р сарын 31-нийхтэй харьцуулж, хэдэн хувиар өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга
question_latin: Valyut buriin 2026 onii 6-r sariin 30-nii khanshiig 2025 onii 12-r sariin 31-niikhtei kharitsuulj, kheden khuviar oorchlogdsoniig garga
question_en: For each currency, compare the June 30, 2026 rate with the December 31, 2025 rate and show the percentage change.
question_mixed: Currency бүрийн 2026.06.30-ны rate-ийг 2025.12.31-нийхтэй харьцуулж % change-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT a.currency_code, a.mid_rate AS rate_2025_12_31, b.mid_rate AS rate_2026_06_30, ROUND(100.0 * (b.mid_rate - a.mid_rate) / a.mid_rate, 2) AS change_pct FROM t2s.exchange_rates a JOIN t2s.exchange_rates b ON b.currency_code = a.currency_code AND b.rate_date = DATE '2026-06-30' WHERE a.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'

question_mn: 2025 оны гүйлгээний тоог улирлаар гаргаж, улирал бүр жилийн нийт гүйлгээний хэдэн хувийг эзэлснийг харуул
question_latin: 2025 onii gvilgeenii toog uliraar gargaj, uliral bvr jiliin niit gvilgeenii heden huwiig ezelsniig haruul
question_en: Show the number of transactions in each quarter of 2025 and each quarter's share of the year's total.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM transaction_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
notes: 1-р улирлын өсөлтийг 2024 оны 4-р улиралтай харьцуулна.

question_mn: Хувь нийлүүлсэн хөрөнгө ерөнхий дэвтэрт хэдэн төгрөгөөр бүртгэгдсэн байна?
question_latin: Huwi niilvvlsen hurungu yerunhii dewtert heden tugrugoor bvrtgegdsen baina?
question_en: How much paid-in capital is recorded in the general ledger?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS paid_in_capital FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '3100' AND dr_cr = 'C'
notes: GL 3100 'Хувь нийлүүлсэн хөрөнгө' — ганц кредит мөр.

question_mn: Хамгийн сүүлийн AML сэрэмжлүүлэг хэдний өдөр илэрсэн бэ?
question_latin: Khamgiin suuliin AML seremjluuleg khedenii odor ilersen be?
question_en: On what date was the most recent AML alert detected?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(detected_date) AS last_detected_date FROM t2s.aml_alerts

question_mn: Одоогоор хаагдаагүй байгаа AML сэрэмжлүүлгүүдээс хамгийн удаж байгаа нь илэрснээсээ хойш хэдэн хоног болж байна?
question_latin: Odoogoor haagdaagvi baigaa AML seremjlvvlgvvdees hamgiin udaj baigaa ni ilersneesee hoish heden honog bolj baina?
question_en: Among AML alerts that are still not closed, how many days have passed since the oldest one was detected?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(CURRENT_DATE - detected_date) AS max_days_open FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE closed_date IS NULL
notes: Хаагдаагүй = closed_date IS NULL (OPEN, UNDER_REVIEW, ESCALATED төлөвүүд); хоног = CURRENT_DATE − detected_date.

question_mn: 2026 онд бүртгэгдсэн үйл ажиллагааны зардлын хамгийн том мөрийн бичилтийн дугаар, огноо, дүнг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 ond burtgegdsen uil ajillagaanii zardliin khamgiin tom moriin bichiltiin dugaar, ognoo, dung garga.
question_en: Give the entry number, posting date and amount of the largest operating-expense line posted in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT entry_no, posting_date, amount_mnt FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5400' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND fiscal_year = 2026 ORDER BY amount_mnt DESC, entry_no LIMIT 1

question_mn: Ерөнхий дэвтэрт нийт хэдэн өөр данс ашиглагдсан бэ?
question_latin: Yerunhii dewtert niit heden uur dans ashiglagdsan be?
question_en: How many distinct GL accounts have been used in the general ledger?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_code) AS account_count FROM t2s.gl_entries

question_mn: Кассын дансны цэвэр хөдөлгөөнийг (дебит хасах кредит) жил бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Kassiin dansnii tsever khodolgooniig (debit khasakh kredit) jil bureer garga.
question_en: Show the net movement of the cash account (debits minus credits) for each year.
gold_sql: SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS net_movement FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '1110' GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year
notes: Касс = GL 1110 (актив): цэвэр хөдөлгөөн = дебит − кредит.

question_mn: Эх систем тус бүрээс ерөнхий дэвтэрт хэдэн мөр орж ирсэн бэ?
question_latin: Eh sistem tus bvrees yerunhii dewtert heden mur orj irsen be?
question_en: How many general-ledger lines came from each source system?
gold_sql: SELECT source_system, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM t2s.gl_entries GROUP BY source_system

question_mn: Ноцтой байдлын түвшин бүрийн сэрэмжлүүлгийн дундаж дүнг гарга.
question_latin: Notstoi baidliin tuvshin buriin seremjluulgiin dundaj dung garga.
question_en: Show the average alert amount for each severity level.
gold_sql: SELECT severity, ROUND(AVG(alert_amount), 2) AS avg_alert_amount FROM t2s.aml_alerts GROUP BY severity

question_mn: AML сэрэмжлүүлэгтэй харилцагчдаас хэд нь одоо хугацаа хэтэрсэн (1+ хоног) зээлтэй вэ?
question_latin: AML seremjlvvlegtei hariltsagchdaas hed ni odoo hugatsaa hetersen (1+ honog) zeeltei we?
question_en: How many customers with AML alerts currently have an overdue (1+ days past due) loan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS customers FROM t2s.aml_alerts a JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND l.days_past_due > 0

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцсийн агшинд төгрөгийн зээлүүдийн хугацаа хэтэрсэн үндсэн төлбөрийг DPD бүлэг тус бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sariin etsiin agshind togrogiin zeeluudiin khugatsaa khetersen undsen tolboriig DPD buleg tus bureer garga.
question_en: At the end-of-June 2026 snapshot, show the overdue principal of MNT loans by DPD bucket.
gold_sql: SELECT h.dpd_bucket, SUM(h.overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = '2026-06-30' AND l.currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY h.dpd_bucket

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрийн эцэст хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээлүүд дунджаар хэдэн хоног хэтэрсэн байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvriin etsest hugatsaa hetersen zeelvvd dundjaar heden honog hetersen baisan be?
question_en: At each quarter-end of 2025, what was the average days past due of overdue loans?
gold_sql: SELECT snapshot_date, ROUND(AVG(days_past_due), 2) AS avg_dpd FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date IN ('2025-03-31', '2025-06-30', '2025-09-30', '2025-12-31') AND days_past_due > 0 GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date

question_mn: 2025 онд Улаанбаатарын салбарууд болон орон нутгийн салбарууд тус тусдаа хэдэн төгрөгийн хүүгийн орлого бүртгэсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond Ulaanbaatariin salbaruud bolon oron nutgiin salbaruud tus tusdaa kheden togrogiin khuugiin orlogo burtgesen be?
question_en: How much interest income did Ulaanbaatar branches and rural branches each record in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.province = 'Улаанбаатар' THEN 'Улаанбаатар' ELSE 'Орон нутаг' END AS region, SUM(g.amount_mnt) AS interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '4100' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' AND g.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1

question_mn: 2025 оны хадгаламжийн журналын дебит болон кредит талын нийт дүнг тус тусад нь гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii hadgalamjiin jurnaliin debit bolon kredit taliin niit dvng tus tusad ni garga.
question_en: Show the total debit and total credit amounts of the deposit journal for 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT dr_cr, SUM(amount_mnt) AS total_mnt FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE journal_code = 'DEP_J' AND fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY dr_cr
notes: Давхар бичилт тул дебит = кредит.

question_mn: 2026 оны 1–6-р сарын сар бүрийн эцсийн агшнуудаас дор хаяж гуравт нь 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн байсан зээл хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2026 ony 1–6-r saryn sar buriin etssiin agshnuudaas dor khayaj guravt ni 30-aas deesh khonog khetersen baisan zeel khed bn
question_en: How many loans were more than 30 days past due in at least three of the month-end snapshots from January to June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM (SELECT loan_id FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND days_past_due > 30 GROUP BY loan_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) x
notes: loan_dpd_history-ийн 2026-01-31 … 2026-06-30 сарын эцсийн агшнуудаас DPD > 30 байсан агшны тоо ≥ 3 зээл.

question_mn: Хаахад 20-оос дээш хоног зарцуулсан сэрэмжлүүлгүүдийн дугаар, дүрмийн нэр, зарцуулсан хоногийг гарга.
question_latin: Khaakhad 20-oos deesh khonog zartsuulsan seremjluulguudiin dugaar, durmiin ner, zartsuulsan khonogiig garga.
question_en: List the alerts that took more than 20 days to close: alert number, rule name and days taken.
gold_sql: SELECT alert_no, rule_name, closed_date - detected_date AS days_to_close FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE closed_date - detected_date > 20

question_mn: 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцсийн агшинд бүртгэгдсэн зээлүүдээс хэд нь 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцсийн агшинд огт бүртгэгдээгүй байна вэ?
question_latin: 2025 onii 12-r sariin etssiin agshind bvrtgegdsen zeelvvdees hed ni 2026 onii 6-r sariin etssiin agshind ogt bvrtgegdeegvi baina we?
question_en: Of the loans recorded in the December 2025 month-end snapshot, how many do not appear at all in the June 2026 month-end snapshot?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dropped_loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a WHERE a.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history b WHERE b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30')
notes: Хоёр агшны хоорондох anti-join (NOT EXISTS): 2025-12-31-нд бүртгэлтэй 1286 зээлээс 2026-06-30-нд бүртгэлгүй (хаагдсан эсвэл хасагдсан) нь 260.

question_mn: 2025 онд олгосон зээлүүдийн хувьд олгосон улирал бүрээр, олгосноос хойш 6 дахь сарын эцэст 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээлийн хувийг гарга (тэр агшинд бүртгэлтэй зээлээр).
question_latin: 2025 ond olgoson zeelvvdiin huwid olgoson uliral bvreer, olgosnoos hoish 6 dahi sariin etsest 30-aas deesh honog hetersen zeeliin huwiig garga (ter agshind bvrtgeltei zeeleer).
question_en: For loans disbursed in 2025, by disbursement quarter, what percentage were more than 30 days past due at the 6th month-end after the disbursement month (among loans present in that snapshot)?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.disbursement_date) AS disb_quarter, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.days_past_due > 30) / COUNT(*), 2) AS mob6_par30_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history h ON h.loan_id = l.loan_id AND h.snapshot_date = (date_trunc('month', l.disbursement_date) + interval '7 month' - interval '1 day')::date WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
notes: MOB6: олгосон сарын эцэс = MOB0, түүнээс 6 сарын дараах сарын эцэс.

question_mn: 2025 онд ерөнхий дэвтэрт бүртгэсэн нийт хүүгийн орлогод салбар бүр хэдэн хувь эзэлсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond yerunhii dewtert bvrtgesen niit hvvgiin orlogod salbar bvr heden huwi ezelsen be?
question_en: What share of the total 2025 interest income booked in the general ledger did each branch account for?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(g.amount_mnt) / SUM(SUM(g.amount_mnt)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '4100' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' AND g.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Үйл ажиллагааны зардал нь 2024 оноос 2025 онд хамгийн их нэмэгдсэн 3 салбарыг нэмэгдсэн дүнтэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Uil ajillagaanii zardal ni 2024 onoos 2025 ond khamgiin ikh nemegdsen 3 salbariig nemegdsen duntei ni garga.
question_en: List the 3 branches whose operating expense increased the most from 2024 to 2025, with the increase amount.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(g.amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE g.fiscal_year = 2025) - SUM(g.amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE g.fiscal_year = 2024) AS opex_increase FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '5400' AND g.dr_cr = 'D' AND g.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY opex_increase DESC NULLS LAST, b.branch_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: 2025 оны сар бүрийн эцсийн 90-ээс дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээлийн тоо болон түүний 3 сарын хөдөлгөөнт дунджийг (өмнөх 2 сарын эцсийг оруулан) гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii sar buriin etsiin 90-ees deesh khonog khetersen zeeliin too bolon tuunii 3 sariin khodolgoont dundjiig (omnokh 2 sariin etsiig oruulan) garga.
question_en: For each 2025 month-end, show the number of loans more than 90 days past due and its 3-month moving average (including the two previous month-ends).
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 90) AS loans_90_plus FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY snapshot_date), w AS (SELECT snapshot_date, loans_90_plus, ROUND(AVG(loans_90_plus) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m FROM m) SELECT snapshot_date, loans_90_plus, moving_avg_3m FROM w WHERE snapshot_date >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY snapshot_date
notes: 2025-01 ба 2025-02-ийн дундажд 2024-11, 2024-12-ийн агшин орно.

question_mn: Данснаас хасагдаж хаагдсан барагдуулалтын кейс хэд байна?
question_latin: Dansnaas hasagdaj haagdsan baragduulaltiin keis hed baina?
question_en: How many collection cases were closed because the loan was written off?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'

question_mn: 2026 онд үнэлгээ хийгдсэн барьцаа хөрөнгө хэд байна?
question_latin: 2026 ond unelgee khiigdsen baritsaa khorongo khed baina?
question_en: How many collateral assets were valued in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.collaterals WHERE valuation_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'

question_mn: Төгрөгөөр бүртгэлтэй идэвхтэй барьцаанаас зах зээлийн үнэлгээ хамгийн өндөр 3-ыг барьцааны дугаар, үнэлгээтэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Tugrugoor bvrtgeltei idewhtei baritsaanaas zah zeeliin vnelgee hamgiin undur 3-iig baritsaanii dugaar, vnelgeetei ni garga.
question_en: Among active MNT-denominated collateral, show the top 3 by market value with collateral number and value.
gold_sql: SELECT collateral_number, market_value FROM t2s.collaterals WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND currency_code = 'MNT' ORDER BY market_value DESC, collateral_number LIMIT 3

question_mn: Байгууллага батлан даагчтай батлан даалт хэд бүртгэлтэй вэ?
question_latin: Baiguullaga batlan daagchtai batlan daalt khed burtgeltei ve?
question_en: How many guarantees are provided by corporate guarantors?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.loan_guarantors WHERE guarantor_type = 'CORPORATE'

question_mn: Биелсэн амлалтуудыг амласан өдрөөсөө дунджаар хэдэн хоногийн зөрүүтэй төлсөн бэ?
question_latin: Bielsen amlaltuudiig amlasan udruusuu dundjaar heden honogiin zuruutei tulsun be?
question_en: On average, how many days from the promised date were kept promises paid (paid date minus promised date)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(paid_date - promised_date), 2) FROM t2s.collection_promises WHERE status = 'KEPT'
notes: Сөрөг утга = амласан өдрөөсөө өмнө төлсөн.

question_mn: Хууль зүйн өмнөх шатанд байгаа хаагдаагүй кейсүүдийн одоогийн нийт үлдэгдэл хэд вэ?
question_latin: Khuuli zuin omnokh shatand baigaa khaagdaagui keisuudiin odoogiin niit uldegdel khed ve?
question_en: What is the current total outstanding of open cases at the pre-legal stage?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(current_outstanding) FROM t2s.collection_cases WHERE stage_code = 'PRE_LEGAL' AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')
notes: PRE_LEGAL шатанд USD кейс байхгүй.

question_mn: Үйлдлийн суваг бүрээр нийт үйлдлийн хэдэн хувийг гэрээт компани гүйцэтгэснийг гарга.
question_latin: Vildliin suwag bvreer niit vildliin heden huwiig gereet kompani gvitsetgesniig garga.
question_en: For each action channel, what percentage of all actions was performed by an external collection agency?
question_mixed: Channel бүрээр нийт action-ий хэдэн хувийг collection agency хийснийг гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(agency_code) / COUNT(*), 2) AS agency_pct FROM t2s.collection_actions GROUP BY channel

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сард айлчлал хийсэн барагдуулагч бүрийн нэр, айлчлалын тоог гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sard ailchlal khiisen baragduulagch buriin ner, ailchlaliin toog garga.
question_en: For each collector who made field visits in June 2026, show the name and the number of visits.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, count(*) AS visit_count FROM t2s.collection_actions a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.performed_by WHERE a.action_code = 'FIELD_VISIT' AND a.action_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY e.full_name

question_mn: Хариуцлагын төрөл бүрээр батлан даалтын дундаж хувь хэд байна?
question_latin: Hariutslagiin turul bvreer batlan daaltiin dundaj huwi hed baina?
question_en: What is the average guarantee percentage for each liability type?
gold_sql: SELECT liability_type, ROUND(AVG(guarantee_pct), 2) AS avg_guarantee_pct FROM t2s.loan_guarantors GROUP BY liability_type

question_mn: Барагдуулагч бүрийн хамгийн сүүлд барагдуулалтын үйлдэл хийсэн огноог нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Baragduulagch bvriin hamgiin svvld baragduulaltiin vildel hiisen ognoog nertei ni garga.
question_en: For each collector, show their name and the date of their most recent collection action.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, MAX(a.action_date) AS last_action_date FROM t2s.collection_actions a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.performed_by GROUP BY e.full_name

question_mn: Хамгийн олон удаа барагдуулалтад орсон харилцагчийн дугаар, кейсийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Hamgiin olon udaa baragduulaltad orson hariltsagchiin dugaar, keisiin toog garga.
question_en: Which customer has had the most collection cases? Show the customer number and the number of cases.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.customer_number, count(*) AS case_count FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_number ORDER BY case_count DESC, cu.customer_number LIMIT 1

question_mn: 2026 оны 1–6-р сард сар бүр хэдэн барьцааг зээлээс чөлөөлсөн бэ? Сарын дугаар, тоог гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 1-6-r sard sar bur kheden baritsaag zeelees choloolson be? Sariin dugaar, toog garga.
question_en: How many collateral pledges were released from loans in each month of January–June 2026? Show the month number and count.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM release_date) AS month_no, count(*) AS released FROM t2s.loan_collaterals WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Барьцаалсан өдрөөсөө хойш 30 хоногийн дотор зээлээс чөлөөлөгдсөн барьцаа хэд байна?
question_latin: Baritsaalsan udruusuu hoish 30 honogiin dotor zeelees chuluulugdsun baritsaa hed baina?
question_en: How many collateral links were released within 30 days of being pledged?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.loan_collaterals WHERE release_date IS NOT NULL AND release_date - pledge_date <= 30

question_mn: Төгрөгийн төлөх амлалтуудын дундаж амласан дүнг амлалтын төлөв бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Togrogiin tolokh amlaltuudiin dundaj amlasan dung amlaltiin tolov bureer garga.
question_en: Show the average promised amount of MNT promises to pay by promise status.
gold_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(promised_amount), 2) AS avg_promised FROM t2s.collection_promises WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' GROUP BY status

question_mn: Барагдуулагч бүрийн өөрөө гүйцэтгэсэн үйлдлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь төлөх амлалт авсан үр дүнтэй байсныг ажилтны нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Baragduulagch bvriin uuruu gvitsetgesen vildlvvdiin heden huwi ni tuluh amlalt awsan vr dvntei baisniig ajiltnii nertei ni garga.
question_en: For each collector, show the name and the percentage of the actions they personally performed that resulted in a promise to pay.
question_mixed: Collector бүрийн хийсэн action-уудын хэдэн хувь нь promise obtained үр дүнтэй байсныг нэртэй нь гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.contact_result = 'PROMISE_OBTAINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS promise_pct FROM t2s.collection_actions a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.performed_by GROUP BY e.full_name

question_mn: Барагдуулалтын шат бүрт хамгийн их дүн цуглуулсан кейсийн дугаар, цуглуулсан дүнг шатны нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Baragduulaltiin shat bvrt hamgiin ih dvn tsugluulsan keisiin dugaar, tsugluulsan dvng shatnii nertei ni garga.
question_en: For each collection stage, show the stage name and the case number and amount of the case with the highest collected amount.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT stage_name, case_no, collected_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stage_name ORDER BY collected_amount DESC, case_no) AS rn FROM t2s.collection_cases) SELECT stage_name, case_no, collected_amount FROM r WHERE rn = 1

question_mn: Барьцаа нь хураагдсан зээлүүдийн барагдуулалтын кейсүүдийг шатны нэрээр нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Baritsaa ni khuraagdsan zeeluudiin baragduulaltiin keisuudiig shatnii nereer ni toolj garga.
question_en: Count the collection cases of loans whose collateral has been seized, by stage name.
gold_sql: SELECT cc.stage_name, count(DISTINCT cc.case_id) AS case_count FROM t2s.collaterals col JOIN t2s.loan_collaterals lc ON lc.collateral_id = col.collateral_id JOIN t2s.collection_cases cc ON cc.loan_id = lc.loan_id WHERE col.encumbrance_status = 'SEIZED' GROUP BY cc.stage_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 1–6-р сард сар бүр хэдэн барьцааг зээлд шинээр барьцаалсныг, мөн оны эхнээс хуримтлагдсан тоог нь гарга (сарын дугаар, тоо, хуримтлагдсан тоо).
question_latin: 2026 onii 1-6-r sard sar bvr heden baritsaag zeeld shineer baritsaalsniig, mun onii ehnees hurimtlagdsan toog ni garga (sariin dugaar, too, hurimtlagdsan too).
question_en: For each month from January to June 2026, show how many collateral assets were newly pledged to loans and the cumulative year-to-date count (month number, count, cumulative count).
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pledge_date) AS month_no, count(*) AS pledged FROM t2s.loan_collaterals WHERE pledge_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month_no, pledged, SUM(pledged) OVER (ORDER BY month_no) AS cumulative FROM m ORDER BY month_no

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр 2025 оны эхний хагаст болон 2026 оны эхний хагаст нээгдсэн кейсийн тоо, өсөлтийн хувийг салбарын нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bureer 2025 onii ekhnii khagast bolon 2026 onii ekhnii khagast neegdsen keisiin too, osoltiin khuviig salbariin nertei ni garga.
question_en: For each branch, show the branch name, the number of cases opened in H1 2025 and in H1 2026, and the growth rate (%).
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30') AS h1_2025, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS h1_2026, ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM t2s.collection_cases c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' OR c.opened_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Барагдуулалтын кейс хариуцаж байгаа нийт хэдэн өөр ажилтан байна вэ?
question_latin: Baragduulaltiin keis hariutsaj baigaa niit heden uur ajiltan baina we?
question_en: How many distinct employees are assigned collection cases?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT assigned_to) FROM t2s.collection_cases

question_mn: Одоо мөрдөж буй жилийн хүү нь хамгийн өндөр зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүн аль вэ? Нэр, хүүг нь хэл.
question_latin: Odoo murduj bui jiliin hvv ni hamgiin undur zeeliin bvteegdehvvn ali we? Ner, hvvg ni hel.
question_en: Which loan product has the highest current annual interest rate? Give its name and rate.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, annual_rate FROM t2s.products WHERE category = 'LOAN' ORDER BY annual_rate DESC, product_id LIMIT 1

question_mn: Хугацаа нь 5 жилээс урт хэдэн зээл багцад байна?
question_latin: Khugatsaa ni 5 jilees urt kheden zeel bagtsad baina?
question_en: How many loans in the portfolio have a term longer than 5 years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND term_months > 60

question_mn: Багц дахь зээлүүдийн дундаж хугацаа хэдэн сар вэ?
question_latin: Bagts dahi zeelvvdiin dundaj hugatsaa heden sar we?
question_en: What is the average term, in months, of the loans in the portfolio?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(term_months), 2) AS avg_term_months FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Торгуулийн үлдэгдэлтэй хэдэн зээл багцад байна?
question_latin: Torguuliin uldegdeltei kheden zeel bagtsad baina?
question_en: How many loans in the portfolio have an outstanding penalty balance?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND penalty_outstanding > 0

question_mn: Зогсоосон бүтээгдэхүүнээр олгогдсон боловч одоо ч багцад байгаа хэдэн зээл байна, үндсэн үлдэгдэл нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: Zogsooson bvteegdehvvneer olgogdson bolowch odoo ch bagtsad baigaa heden zeel baina, vndsen vldegdel ni hed we?
question_en: How many loans issued under discontinued products are still in the portfolio, and what is their principal outstanding?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND l.is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Өмнө нь 60-аас дээш хоног хэтэрч байсан ч одоо хугацаа хэтрэлтгүй болсон хэдэн зээл багцад байна?
question_latin: Umnu ni 60-aas deesh honog hetrej baisan ch odoo hugatsaa hetreltgvi bolson heden zeel bagtsad baina?
question_en: How many portfolio loans were once more than 60 days past due but are now current?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND max_days_past_due > 60 AND days_past_due = 0

question_mn: Хугацаа хэтэрсэн (1+ хоног) зээлүүдээс нэг ч төлөлт хийгдээгүй нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: Hugatsaa hetersen (1+ honog) zeelvvdees neg ch tulult hiigdeegvi ni hed we?
question_en: Among overdue (1+ days past due) loans, how many have never received a single payment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND days_past_due > 0 AND last_payment_date IS NULL

question_mn: Гэрээ байгуулснаас хойш зээл олгох хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног болдог вэ?
question_latin: Geree baiguulsnaas khoish zeel olgokh khurtel dundjaar kheden khonog boldog ve?
question_en: On average, how many days pass between signing the loan contract and disbursement?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(disbursement_date - contract_date), 2) AS avg_days FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date IS NOT NULL

question_mn: 2024 онд олгосон зээлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь өнөөдрийн байдлаар бүрэн төлөгдөж хаагдсан бэ?
question_latin: 2024 ond olgoson zeelvvdiin heden huwi ni unuudriin baidlaar bvren tulugduj haagdsan be?
question_en: What percentage of loans disbursed in 2024 have been fully repaid and closed as of today?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 'CLOSED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS closed_pct FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

question_mn: Багцын хугацаа хэтэрсэн хүүгийн нийт дүн төгрөгөөр хэд вэ?
question_latin: Bagtsiin khugatsaa khetersen khuugiin niit dun togrogoor khed ve?
question_en: What is the total overdue interest of the portfolio, in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(overdue_interest * fx_rate_to_mnt) AS overdue_interest_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio
notes: overdue_interest нь зээлийн валютаар тул fx_rate_to_mnt-ээр үржүүлж төгрөгт шилжүүлнэ.

question_mn: E0023 дугаартай зээлийн мэргэжилтэн багцад хэдэн зээл хариуцаж байна, үндсэн үлдэгдэл нь хэд вэ?
question_latin: E0023 dugaartai zeeliin mergejilten bagtsad heden zeel hariutsaj baina, vndsen vldegdel ni hed we?
question_en: How many portfolio loans does loan officer E0023 manage, and what is their principal outstanding?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = l.loan_officer_id WHERE e.employee_no = 'E0023' AND l.is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Барьцаа шаарддаг бүтээгдэхүүнүүдээр олгосон зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдэл хэд вэ?
question_latin: Baritsaa shaarddag bvteegdehvvnvvdeer olgoson zeeliin bagtsiin vndsen vldegdel hed we?
question_en: What is the portfolio principal outstanding of loans under products that require collateral?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND p.requires_collateral

question_mn: Дижитал салбараас олгосон зээлүүдийн дундаж дүн болон дундаж хугацааг гарга.
question_latin: Dijital salbaraas olgoson zeeluudiin dundaj dun bolon dundaj khugatsaag garga.
question_en: Show the average amount and average term of loans disbursed by the digital branch.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(l.principal_amount_mnt) AS avg_amount_mnt, ROUND(AVG(l.term_months), 2) AS avg_term_months FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE b.branch_type = 'DIGITAL' AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн хамгийн сүүлд зээл олгосон огноог гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvriin hamgiin svvld zeel olgoson ognoog garga.
question_en: Show the most recent loan disbursement date for each branch.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, MAX(l.disbursement_date) AS last_disbursement_date FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Хяналтад ангилалтай зээлүүд дунджаар хэдэн хоног хэтэрсэн байна?
question_latin: Khyanaltad angilaltai zeeluud dundjaar kheden khonog khetersen baina?
question_en: On average, how many days past due are the loans classified as 'watch'?
question_mixed: Watch ангилалтай зээлүүдийн average DPD хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_past_due), 2) AS avg_dpd FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND classification_code = 'WATCH'

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүн бүрээр үр ашигт хүү нэрлэсэн хүүнээс дунджаар хэдэн нэгж хувиар өндөр байгааг гарга.
question_latin: Bvteegdehvvn bvreer vr ashigt hvv nerlesen hvvnees dundjaar heden negj huwiar undur baigaag garga.
question_en: For each product, show by how many percentage points the effective rate exceeds the nominal rate on average.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(l.effective_rate - l.interest_rate), 2) AS avg_rate_gap FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр нэг зээлдэгчид багц дахь хэдэн зээл дунджаар ногдож байгааг гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvreer neg zeeldegchid bagts dahi heden zeel dundjaar nogdoj baigaag garga.
question_en: For each branch, show the average number of portfolio loans per borrower.
question_mixed: Салбар бүрээр нэг borrower-т ногдох portfolio-ийн зээлийн дундаж тоог гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id), 2) AS loans_per_borrower FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Багцад зээлтэй хувь хүн харилцагчдын дундаж нас хэд вэ?
question_latin: Bagtsad zeeltei khuvi khun khariltsagchdiin dundaj nas khed ve?
question_en: What is the average age of individual customers who have a loan in the portfolio?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.age), 2) AS avg_age FROM t2s.individuals i WHERE i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio)
notes: Харилцагч тус бүрийг нэг удаа тооцно (зээлээр JOIN хийвэл олон зээлтэй хүн давхцана).

question_mn: Хүү нь өөрийн бүтээгдэхүүний багц дахь дундаж хүүнээс 1 нэгж хувиас илүү өндөр хэдэн зээл байна?
question_latin: Hvv ni uuriin bvteegdehvvnii bagts dahi dundaj hvvnees 1 negj huwias ilvv undur heden zeel baina?
question_en: How many portfolio loans have an interest rate more than 1 percentage point above the average rate of their own product in the portfolio?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM (SELECT interest_rate, AVG(interest_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_avg FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio) t WHERE interest_rate > product_avg + 1

question_mn: Зээлийн багцын үндсэн үлдэгдлээрээ хоёрдугаарт орж буй салбар аль вэ?
question_latin: Zeeliin bagtsiin undsen uldegdleeree khoyordugaart orj bui salbar ali ve?
question_en: Which branch ranks second by loan portfolio principal outstanding?
gold_sql: SELECT branch_name FROM (SELECT b.branch_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) DESC) AS rnk FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name) t WHERE rnk = 2

question_mn: LN-2025-000208 зээл дээр өнөөдрийг хүртэл нийт хэдэн төгрөг төлөгдсөн бэ?
question_latin: LN-2025-000208 zeel deer unuudriig hvrtel niit heden tugrug tulugdsun be?
question_en: How much in total has been paid on loan LN-2025-000208 to date?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM t2s.loan_payments p JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = p.loan_id WHERE l.loan_number = 'LN-2025-000208' AND p.status = 'POSTED'

question_mn: Олголтын шимтгэл нь одоо болтол төлөгдөөгүй байгаа зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Olgoltiin shimtgel n odoo boltol tulugduugvi baigaa zeel hed baina?
question_en: How many loans still have an unpaid disbursement fee?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loan_charges WHERE charge_code = 'DISBURSEMENT_FEE' AND status IN ('CHARGED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID')

question_mn: Эргэн төлөлтийн хуваарийн хэдэн төлөлт дээр торгууль тооцогдсон байна?
question_latin: Ergen tulultiin huwaariin heden tulult deer torguuli tootsogdson baina?
question_en: On how many schedule installments has a penalty been charged?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS installment_count FROM t2s.loan_schedule WHERE penalty_charged > 0

question_mn: Бүтцийн өөрчлөлтүүдийг шалтгаан бүрээр нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Butsiin oorchloltuudiig shaltgaan bureer n toolj garga.
question_en: Count the loan restructurings by reason.
gold_sql: SELECT reason, count(*) AS restructure_count FROM t2s.loan_restructures GROUP BY reason

question_mn: Энэ сард данснаас хассан зээлүүдийн дугаар, бүтээгдэхүүний нэр, хассан нийт дүнг жагсаа.
question_latin: Ene sard dansnaas hassan zeelvvdiin dugaar, bvteegdehvvnii ner, hassan niit dvng jagsaa.
question_en: List the loan number, product name and total written-off amount of loans written off this month.
gold_sql: SELECT l.loan_number, pr.product_name, w.total_amount FROM t2s.loan_writeoffs w JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = w.loan_id JOIN t2s.products pr ON pr.product_id = l.product_id WHERE w.writeoff_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Төлбөрийн чөлөө олгох замаар бүтэц өөрчилсөн зээлүүдийн дугаар болон өөрчлөлт хүчин төгөлдөр болсон огноог жагсаа.
question_latin: Tolboriin choloo olgokh zamaar butets oorchilson zeeluudiin dugaar bolon oorchlolt khuchin togoldor bolson ognoog jagsaa.
question_en: List the loan numbers and effective dates of restructurings done by granting a payment holiday.
gold_sql: SELECT l.loan_number, r.effective_date FROM t2s.loan_restructures r JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = r.loan_id WHERE r.restructure_type = 'PAYMENT_HOLIDAY'

question_mn: 2026 онд орсон төгрөгийн хамгийн том 3 эргэн төлөлтийн дугаар, огноо, дүнг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 ond orson tugrugiin hamgiin tom 3 ergen tulultiin dugaar, ognoo, dvng garga.
question_en: Show the payment number, date and amount of the 3 largest MNT repayments received in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT payment_no, payment_date, amount FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_no LIMIT 3

question_mn: Одоо төлөгдөөгүй байгаа төгрөгийн торгуулиудыг хоцорсон хоногоор нь 1-30, 31-90, 90-ээс дээш гэж ангилаад бүлэг бүрийн тоо, дүнг гарга.
question_latin: Odoo tologdoogui baigaa togrogiin torguuliudiig khotsorson khonogoor n 1-30, 31-90, 90-ees deesh gej angilaad buleg buriin too, dung garga.
question_en: Group the currently unpaid MNT penalties by days overdue into 1-30, 31-90 and over 90 days, and show the count and amount per group.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN days_overdue <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN days_overdue <= 90 THEN '31-90' ELSE '90+' END AS dpd_group, count(*) AS penalty_count, SUM(amount - paid_amount - waived_amount) AS unpaid_amount FROM t2s.loan_charges WHERE charge_type = 'PENALTY' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND status IN ('CHARGED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID') GROUP BY 1

question_mn: 2025 онд төлбөр орсон зээлүүдэд нэг зээлд дунджаар хэдэн эргэн төлөлт ногдож байна?
question_latin: 2025 ond tulbur orson zeelvvded neg zeeld dundjaar heden ergen tulult nogdoj baina?
question_en: In 2025, how many repayments were received per loan on average, among loans that received payments?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT loan_id), 2) AS payments_per_loan FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: Хугацаанаас өмнө бүрэн хаагдсан зээлүүд олгосноосоо хойш дунджаар хэдэн хоногийн дараа хаагдсан бэ?
question_latin: Khugatsaanaas omno buren khaagdsan zeeluud olgosnoosoo khoish dundjaar kheden khonogiin daraa khaagdsan be?
question_en: On average, how many days after disbursement were early-repaid loans paid off?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.payment_date - l.disbursement_date), 2) AS avg_days FROM t2s.loan_payments p JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = p.loan_id WHERE p.payment_type = 'EARLY_FULL' AND p.status = 'POSTED'

question_mn: Данснаас хассан зээлийн нөхөн төлөлт хамгийн сүүлд хэзээ орсон бэ?
question_latin: Dansnaas hassan zeeliin nuhun tulult hamgiin svvld hezee orson be?
question_en: When was the most recent recovery payment on a written-off loan received?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(payment_date) AS last_recovery_date FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE payment_type = 'RECOVERY' AND status = 'POSTED'

question_mn: Хуваарь нь бүтцийн өөрчлөлтөөр шинэчлэгдсэн (2-р хувилбартай) хэдэн зээл байна?
question_latin: Khuvaari n butsiin oorchloltoor shinechlegdsen (2-r khuvilbartai) kheden zeel baina?
question_en: How many loans have a schedule that was replaced by restructuring (schedule version 2)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loan_schedule WHERE schedule_version = 2

question_mn: Өнөөдөр төлөх хугацаатай хуваарийн төлөлт хэд байна?
question_latin: Unuudur tuluh hugatsaatai huwaariin tulult hed baina?
question_en: How many installments are due today?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS installment_count FROM t2s.loan_schedule WHERE due_date = CURRENT_DATE

question_mn: Хугацаа хэтрүүлсний торгуулиудаас хамгийн удаан хоцорч тооцогдсон нь хэдэн хоног байна?
question_latin: Hugatsaa hetrvvlsnii torguuliudaas hamgiin udaan hotsorch tootsogdson n heden honog baina?
question_en: What is the largest number of overdue days for which a late-payment penalty has been charged?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(days_overdue) AS max_days_overdue FROM t2s.loan_charges WHERE charge_type = 'PENALTY'

question_mn: 2025 онд төгрөгийн зээлүүдээр орсон эргэн төлөлтийн нийт дүнгийн хэдэн хувь нь үндсэн төлбөр, хүү, торгууль, шимтгэлд тус тус хуваарилагдсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond tugrugiin zeelvvdeer orson ergen tuluultiin niit dvngiin heden huwi ni vndsen tulbur, hvv, torguuli, shimtgeld tus tus huwaarilagdsan be?
question_en: In 2025, what percentage of total repayments on MNT loans was allocated to principal, interest, penalty and fees respectively?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(allocated_principal) / SUM(amount), 2) AS principal_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(allocated_interest) / SUM(amount), 2) AS interest_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(allocated_penalty) / SUM(amount), 2) AS penalty_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(allocated_fee) / SUM(amount), 2) AS fee_pct FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: 2025 онд нэг зээлийн дараалсан хоёр эргэн төлөлтийн хооронд дунджаар хэдэн хоног байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond neg zeeliin daraalsan hoyor ergen tuluultiin hoorond dundjaar heden honog baisan be?
question_en: In 2025, what was the average number of days between two consecutive repayments of the same loan?
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT payment_date - LAG(payment_date) OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY payment_date, payment_no) AS gap_days FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap_days), 2) AS avg_gap_days FROM g WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL

question_mn: Бүтэц өөрчилсөн зээлүүд одоо ямар төлөвтэй байгааг төлөв тус бүрээр тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Bvtets uurchilsun zeelvvd odoo yamar tuluwtei baigaag tuluw tus bvreer toolj garga.
question_en: Count the restructured loans by their current status.
gold_sql: SELECT status_name, count(*) AS loan_count FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_restructured GROUP BY status_name

question_mn: LN-2025-000648 зээлийн цаашид төлөх ёстой хүүгийн нийт дүн хэд вэ?
question_latin: LN-2025-000648 zeeliin tsaashid tolokh yostoi khuugiin niit dun khed ve?
question_en: What is the total interest still to be paid on loan LN-2025-000648 according to its schedule?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.interest_due) AS future_interest FROM t2s.loan_schedule s JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id WHERE l.loan_number = 'LN-2025-000648' AND s.status = 'PENDING'

question_mn: Ховд салбарын хугацаа хэтэрсэн төлөвтэй зээл бүрийн хамгийн сүүлд хийсэн амжилттай төлбөрийн огноо, дүнг зээлийн дугаартай нь гарга.
question_latin: Howd salbariin hugatsaa hetersen tuluwtei zeel bvriin hamgiin svvld hiisen amjilttai tulburiin ognoo, dvng zeeliin dugaartai n garga.
question_en: For each loan with overdue status at the Khovd branch, show the loan number with the date and amount of its most recent successful payment.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT l.loan_number, p.payment_date, p.amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.loan_id ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC NULLS LAST, p.payment_no DESC) AS rn FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id LEFT JOIN t2s.loan_payments p ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id AND p.status = 'POSTED' WHERE b.branch_name = 'Ховд салбар' AND l.status_code = 'OVERDUE') SELECT loan_number, payment_date, amount FROM t WHERE rn = 1

question_mn: Хугацаанаас өмнө бүрэн хаагдсан зээлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь хугацаанаас өмнө төлсний шимтгэл төлсөн бэ?
question_latin: Khugatsaanaas omno buren khaagdsan zeeluudiin kheden khuvi n khugatsaanaas omno tolsnii shimtgel tolson be?
question_en: What percentage of loans that were repaid early in full also paid an early-repayment fee?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loan_charges c WHERE c.loan_id = e.loan_id AND c.charge_code = 'EARLY_REPAY_FEE')) / count(*), 2) AS fee_share_pct FROM (SELECT DISTINCT loan_id FROM t2s.loan_payments WHERE payment_type = 'EARLY_FULL' AND status = 'POSTED') e

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцын зээлийн жигнэсэн дундаж хүү, идэвхтэй хадгаламжийн жигнэсэн дундаж хүү болон тэдгээрийн зөрүүг (спред) гарга.
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsiin zeeliin jignesen dundaj hvv, idewhtei hadgalamjiin jignesen dundaj hvv bolon tedgeeriin zurvvg (spred) garga.
question_en: Show the weighted average interest rate of active-portfolio loans, the weighted average rate of active deposits, and the spread between them.
question_mixed: Active-portfolio loan болон active deposit-ийн weighted average rate, тэдгээрийн spread-ийг гарга.
gold_sql: WITH lr AS (SELECT SUM(interest_rate * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS loan_rate FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio), dr AS (SELECT SUM(interest_rate * current_balance_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(current_balance_mnt), 0) AS deposit_rate FROM t2s.deposits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') SELECT ROUND(lr.loan_rate, 2) AS loan_rate, ROUND(dr.deposit_rate, 2) AS deposit_rate, ROUND(lr.loan_rate - dr.deposit_rate, 2) AS spread FROM lr CROSS JOIN dr

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрээр шинээр бүртгүүлсэн харилцагчийн тоо болон олгосон зээлийн тоог зэрэгцүүлж гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar bvreer shineer bvrtgvvlsen hariltsagchiin too bolon olgoson zeeliin toog zeregtsvvlj garga.
question_en: For each month of 2026, show the number of newly onboarded customers alongside the number of loans disbursed.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', onboarded_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), l AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', disbursement_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.month, c.new_customers, l.new_loans FROM c JOIN l ON l.month = c.month ORDER BY c.month

question_mn: Ирэх 7 хоногт идэвхтэй төгрөгийн зээлүүдээс хуваарийн дагуу төлөгдөх ёстой нийт дүнг салбар бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Ireh 7 honogt idewhtei tugrugiin zeelvvdees huwaariin daguu tulugduh yostoi niit dvng salbar bvreer garga.
question_en: By branch, show the total scheduled amount due on active MNT loans over the next 7 days.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(s.total_due) AS due_next_7_days FROM t2s.loan_schedule s JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = s.loan_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.currency_code = 'MNT' AND l.is_active_portfolio AND s.due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7 GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Барьцаа хөрөнгө нь хураагдсан зээлүүдийг салбараар нь тоолж, үндсэн үлдэгдлийн хамт гарга.
question_latin: Baritsaa khorongo ni khuraagdsan zeeluudiig salbaraar ni toolj, undsen uldegdliin khamt garga.
question_en: By branch, count the loans whose collateral has been seized and show their principal outstanding.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.loan_collaterals lc ON lc.loan_id = l.loan_id JOIN t2s.collaterals c ON c.collateral_id = lc.collateral_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE c.encumbrance_status = 'SEIZED' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Одоо ажиллаж байгаа зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдийг ажилд орсноосоо хойшхи хугацаагаар нь 2 жил хүртэл, 2–5 жил, 5-аас дээш жил гэж ангилаад, бүлэг бүрийн хариуцсан идэвхтэй багцын PAR30-ийг гарга.
question_latin: Odoo ajillaj baigaa zeeliin mergejiltnvvdiig ajild orsnoosoo hoishhi hugatsaagaar ni 2 jil hvrtel, 2–5 jil, 5-aas deesh jil gej angilaad, bvleg bvriin hariutssan idewhtei bagtsiin PAR30-iig garga.
question_en: Group currently working credit officers by time since hire (up to 2 years, 2–5 years, more than 5 years) and show the PAR30 of the active portfolio each group manages.
question_mixed: Active loan officer-уудыг tenure-аар нь 2 жил хүртэл, 2–5 жил, 5+ жил гэж bucket-лаад bucket бүрийн portfolio PAR30-ийг гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN e.hire_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 year' THEN '2 жил хүртэл' WHEN e.hire_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 year' THEN '2–5 жил' ELSE '5-аас дээш жил' END AS tenure_group, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = l.loan_officer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1
notes: Одоо ажиллаж байгаа = employment_status = 'ACTIVE'; ажилласан хугацааг өнөөдрөөр (2026-06-30) тооцно. PAR30 = glossary (үндсэн үлдэгдлээр).

question_mn: Зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр барагдуулалтын нэг кейст дунджаар хэдэн үйлдэл хийгдэж, хэдэн төгрөгийн зардал гарсныг төрлийн нэрээр гарга.
question_latin: Zeeliin buteegdekhuunii torol bureer baragduulaltyn neg keist dundjaar kheden uildel khiigdej, kheden togrogiin zardal garsnyg torliin nereer garga.
question_en: For each loan product type, show the average number of collection actions and the average action cost per collection case, by product type name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, ROUND(COUNT(a.action_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.case_id), 2) AS avg_actions_per_case, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(a.cost_amount), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.case_id), 2) AS avg_cost_per_case FROM t2s.collection_cases cc JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = cc.loan_id JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN t2s.collection_actions a ON a.case_id = cc.case_id GROUP BY p.product_type_name
notes: Кейсийн үйлдлийг LEFT JOIN-оор нийлүүлж, бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр кейсийн тоонд (COUNT DISTINCT) хуваана; одоогоор бүх кейс дор хаяж нэг үйлдэлтэй.

question_mn: Сүүлийн төлбөрөөс хойш 60-аас дээш хоног өнгөрсөн идэвхтэй багцын зээлүүдийг салбараар тоолж, үндсэн үлдэгдлийнх нь хамт гарга.
question_latin: Suuliin tolboroos khoish 60-aas deesh khonog ongorson idevkhtei bagtsiin zeeluudiig salbaraar toolj, undsen uldegdliinkh ni khamt garga.
question_en: By branch, count the active-portfolio loans whose last payment was more than 60 days ago, together with their principal outstanding.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND l.last_payment_date < CURRENT_DATE - 60 GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Нэг ч төлбөр хийгдээгүй (last_payment_date NULL) зээл орохгүй.

question_mn: Гэрээт барагдуулалтын компаниудад шилжүүлсэн кейсүүдийг зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүнээр нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Gereet baragduulaltiin kompaniudad shiljvvlsen keisvvdiig zeeliin bvteegdehvvneer ni toolj garga.
question_en: Count the collection cases assigned to external collection agencies by loan product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM t2s.collection_cases cc JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = cc.loan_id JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE cc.agency_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: Харилцагч хариуцдаг ажилтан бүрээр хариуцсан харилцагчийн тоо, тэдгээр харилцагчдын идэвхтэй багцын зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гаргаж, хамгийн олон харилцагчтай 5 ажилтныг харуул.
question_latin: Hariltsagch hariutsdag ajiltan bvreer hariutssan hariltsagchiin too, tedgeer hariltsagchdiin idewhtei bagtsiin zeeliin vndsen vldegdliig gargaj, hamgiin olon hariltsagchtai 5 ajiltniig haruul.
question_en: For each relationship manager, show the number of customers assigned and those customers' active-portfolio loan principal outstanding; list the 5 managers with the most customers.
gold_sql: WITH rm AS (SELECT relationship_manager_id, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE relationship_manager_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY relationship_manager_id), lo AS (SELECT c.relationship_manager_id, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS portfolio FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.relationship_manager_id) SELECT e.full_name, rm.customers, lo.portfolio FROM rm JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = rm.relationship_manager_id LEFT JOIN lo ON lo.relationship_manager_id = rm.relationship_manager_id ORDER BY rm.customers DESC, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Данснаас хассан зээлүүдийн хувьд барагдуулалтын кейс нээгдсэнээс данснаас хасах хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног өнгөрсөн бэ?
